title: Test Engineer
description:
Minimum qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, and 3 years of experience in the job offered or in a Test Engineer-related occupation.
  • Position requires 3 years of experience in the following: Developing test methodologies, writing test plans, creating test cases, or defining and documenting test strategy for various RF technologies including cellular, WiFi, BT, and UWB on both MLB and OTA levels for consumer hardware; Analyzing systems architecture and applying systems thinking to decompose systems into testable components; Applying knowledge of the product development lifecycle to software testing, firmware testing, and hardware performance validation; Designing, writing, testing, and maintaining software applications using one or more programming languages; and Utilizing test automation tools or creating and using test automation frameworks to set up test functions and evaluate outcomes.

About The Job

Google's mission is to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful. Our Devices & Services team combines the best of Google AI, Software, and Hardware to create radically helpful experiences for users. We research, design, and develop new technologies and hardware to make our user's interaction with computing faster, seamless, and more powerful. Whether finding new ways to capture and sense the world around us, advancing form factors, or improving interaction methods, the Devices & Services team is making people's lives better through technology.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $201,100 - $218,000 + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits determined by role, level, and location. Individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Learn more about benefits at Google .

The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and use of automation tools and scripts to improve product health and engineering efficiency;
  • Develop comprehensive test plans based on product strategies and lead review sessions with cross-functional teams;
  • Define and promote new test frameworks, preconditions, and reporting functions to enable effective functionality testing;
  • Drive initiatives to create new or improve existing test infrastructure for increased productivity in test development and deployment;
  • Influence product design and the release cycle by participating in design reviews and contributing to code quality; and Analyze test outcomes, debug failures, and synthesize data into actionable insights for engineering and product stakeholders. International Travel Required

Sunday focuses on the psychology of care, companionship, and empathy. We build accessible worlds where players don't just solve puzzles, they rescue friends. By combining mass-market accessibility with deep emotional hooks, we are defining the next era of digital entertainment.

You must be available to work on-site from Hamburg, Germany.

What you will do:

  • Release Ownership: Take full responsibility for testing all new game features within a release. You will analyze design documents, create the test plan, execute the tests, and verify the final fixes.
  • Bug Life-cycle Management: Identify, document, and track bugs using project and sprint tools. Assist in root cause analysis along with developers. You will be responsible for following up with different stakeholders including, Game Designers, Artists, Products etc. to ensure your "owned" topics are resolved.
  • Regression & Performance: Help ensure that new updates don't break existing features and that the game runs smoothly across different hardware.
  • Documentation: Maintain and update our internal documentation for features you oversee and test.
  • Task Management: Understand priority of features and bugs to maintain project velocity. Act as an advisor to stakeholders regarding prioritization of known and discovered issues.
  • User Advocate: Understand our user base and how they interact with a product. Provide constructive feedback on how users may interact with planned features and how those features may interact with each other.

Who you are:

  • You have at least 2 years of experience in QA
  • Self-Starter: You don’t wait for a task to be assigned. If you see a problem, you investigate it and bring a solution to the table.
  • End-to-End Thinker: You care about the "Why" and "How," not just the "What." You want to understand how a bug affects the player and the production timeline.
  • Gamer at Heart: You have a deep passion for video games and an analytical eye for what makes a game "feel" polished.
  • Curious & Technical: You are comfortable learning new tools and potentially diving into the tech side of games to help diagnose issues.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, or other project management tools.
  • Deep passion for AI and automation tooling.
  • Basic knowledge of scripting or game engines.
  • Basic knowledge of ad network functionality.
  • Previous experience in a startup or fast-paced environment.

Fuel for the Adventure: What You Get at Sunday

  • Build Your Skills, Not Just Your CV: At Sunday, you grow by doing. Real ownership, fast feedback, and steep learning curves are the norm. We don’t just offer development programs – we offer real problems to solve and the space to own them.
  • Flexible Setup for Maximum Impact: We work in a hybrid setup with three core office days, plus flexibility where it matters.
  • Work Where It Feels Good: Our office has a 5th floor Alster lake view, strong coffee, top gear, and way too many snacks. But more than that – it’s a space designed for makers, thinkers, and game-changers to connect, collide, and build.
  • More Than Just a Job – Join the Crew: We don’t just work side by side. We share wins, tackle challenges, and have fun together. Team events, game nights, spontaneous pizza runs – they’re part of the ride. Work hard, play smart.

If you want to build the future of digital companionship, Sunday is your home. Apply now!

title: Test Engineer (f/m/d)

We empower over 1.2 million users across 30,000 companies, including top consulting firms and major global enterprises. With offices in Berlin, Denver, Boston, London, Tokyo, and Dubai, we’re a diverse team of over 150 people, committed to innovation and excellence.


Think-cell is more than a job – it's a chance to be part of an innovative, inclusive team that values collaboration and growth. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply. Together, we can shape the future of productivity software. We can’t wait to see what you’ll bring to the team!
